cats._note: Human-like cat-emoji replies to people who comment on the last watch_posts posts, ONCE per (post, commenter) -- a second comment under the SAME post is ignored, but the same person on another post is eligible again (see minions/aggregator/cats.py). Turn off with enabled=false. Get more premium cat-emoji ids with the /emojis dump helper. tz_offset_hours is the persona's UTC offset (3 = Moscow) so hours match the legend. active_start_hour/active_end_hour are the host's (NAS) uptime window in local hours [start, end): outside it no cat is scheduled, so a bot that runs only 7-17 never plans a cat for a dead hour -- and a cat planned near the edge that would land after shutdown survives in the persisted pending queue and fires when the host is back (set start>=end or 0/24 for always-on). hours_* are [mean_hour, sigma, weight] Gaussian peaks (keep them inside the uptime window); quiet_hours are extra near-silent hours inside the window. State (mood, watched posts, and pending cats) persists to cats_state.json, so a nightly shutdown loses nothing. latency_* is the log-normal reaction delay after a comment; spacing_* is the heavy-tailed gap between cats (bursts then silence). skip_prob ignores a comment; silent_day_prob mutes a whole day; double_prob sends a rare second cat. recency_half_life_sec fades a just-used cat; mood_phi/mood_sigma is the day-to-day AR(1) mood; a cat's tags (sleepy/bodry/winter/spring/summer/autumn/newyear) re-weight it by daypart/season. comments_in_discussion=true (default here) is for a CHANNEL target: each post's comments live in the linked discussion group, so the bot resolves the post's discussion thread and replies ONLY inside that channel post's comments. The account MUST be a member of the discussion group to receive those comments. Set comments_in_discussion=false only when the target is a plain group (then comments are matched as direct replies to the post message id).

status_help: Как это работает. Агрегатор собирает ссылки одного видео со всех площадок в ОДИН пост. Пока пришли не все площадки и не истёк таймаут -- видео 'в пендинге' (ждёт). Как только собраны все или вышло время -- постим. Слишком длинные (не Shorts) отклоняются (rejected). Коты: на коммент под одним из последних постов бот один раз отвечает премиум кот-эмодзи по человечному расписанию -- иногда пачкой, иногда тишина по несколько дней, ночью молчит, иногда вообще пропускает. Один раз на человека ПОД КОНКРЕТНЫМ постом: второй коммент того же человека под тем же постом остаётся без ответа, но под другим постом ему снова может прилететь кот. Команды: /status -- это сообщение; /preview -- примеры постов; /emojis -- id премиум-эмодзи.
_note: Emoji are premium {id, fallback} entries (render from a user account with Telegram Premium). Replace an entry with a plain glyph string like "🔥" to use a non-premium emoji. Add more love/announce variants freely.
